LanguageData.SF_Tab_Manage_Tooltip: View and manage currently built upgrades. Toggle, deconstruct, or expand stackable upgrades.
LanguageData.SF_Tab_Control_Tooltip: Quick access to toggle switches for powered and fueled upgrades.
LanguageData.SF_Tab_Construction_Tooltip: Browse and build new upgrades organized by category.
LanguageData.SF_ManageTab_NoUpgrades: No upgrades built yet. Switch to the Construction tab to add upgrades.
LanguageData.SF_ControlTab_NoToggleables: No toggleable upgrades installed.\n\nBuild upgrades like heaters, coolers, or white noise machines to see toggle controls here.
LanguageData.SF_DisableReason_InsufficientCount: Disabled: Not enough constructed (requires one per bed)
LanguageData.SF_Tooltip_ToggledOff: This upgrade has been manually toggled off. Click to re-enable.
LanguageData.SF_Tooltip_NoPower: This upgrade requires power but the staircase has no power connection.
LanguageData.SF_Tooltip_OutOfFuel: This upgrade requires fuel but the staircase has run out.
LanguageData.SF_Tooltip_InsufficientCount: This upgrade requires one instance per bed, but not enough have been constructed.
LanguageData.SF_Tooltip_ReachedTemperature: This upgrade is on standby because the desired temperature has already been reached.
LanguageData.SF_Tooltip_RequiresUpgrades: This upgrade requires other upgrades to be installed first.
LanguageData.SF_Tooltip_SkillsUnavailable: No colonist has the required construction or artistic skill level for this upgrade.
LanguageData.SF_BuildMore_Tooltip: Build {0} more {1} upgrade(s) to complete installation.
LanguageData.SF_NotEnoughSpaceMessage: Not enough space for this upgrade!
LanguageData.SF_MustPlaceOnStaircase: Must be placed on a staircase.
LanguageData.SF_AlreadyHasUpgrade: This staircase already has the {0} upgrade.
LanguageData.SF_UpgradeNotForThisStaircase: This upgrade cannot be applied to this type of staircase.
LanguageData.SF_UpgradeAlreadyPlanned: The {0} upgrade is already planned for this staircase.
LanguageData.SF_UpgradeUnderConstruction: The {0} upgrade is already under construction.
LanguageData.SF_BedAssignmentsReset: Bed assignments for {0} have been reset. Only {1} bed space(s) are now available.
LanguageData.SF_PreferFueledFirst_Tooltip: When both fueled and electric temperature changers are installed, fueled sources (braziers, campfires) will be used first to reach the desired temperature, with electric backup.
LanguageData.SF_PreferElectricFirst_Tooltip: When both fueled and electric temperature changers are installed, electric sources will be used first to reach the desired temperature, with fueled backup.
LanguageData.SF_ToggleOffTooltip: Turn off this upgrade. While off, it won't consume fuel or power and won't provide any effects.
LanguageData.SF_ToggleOnTooltip: Turn on this upgrade. It will resume consuming fuel or power and provide its effects.
LanguageData.SF_OnePerBedDirect: This upgrade is installed directly on each bed ({0} required). You have {1} constructed. Click to place {2} more blueprint(s) to reach the required amount.
LanguageData.SF_OnePerBedAmbientBarracks: This ambient upgrade is shared between beds in barracks (only {0} required instead of {1}). You have {2} constructed. Click to place {3} more blueprint(s) to reach the required amount.
LanguageData.SF_PowerUsagePerBedAmbient: Power Usage: {0}W per bed (halved in barracks)
LanguageData.SF_TooCloseToAnotherStaircase: Must be at least 10 cells from another staircase of the same type.
LanguageData.SF_MustPlaceUnderMountain: Must be placed under overhead mountain or rock roof.
LanguageData.SF_ExpandBasement_Tooltip: Order miners to excavate {0} additional spaces for the basement. Current: {1}/{2}
LanguageData.SF_ExpandBasement_Maxed_Tooltip: This basement has reached maximum expansion ({0} spaces).
LanguageData.SF_ExpandBasement_InProgress_Tooltip: Miners are currently excavating. Wait for completion or cancel the mining designations to stop.
LanguageData.SF_NotEnoughFreeCells: Not enough free space around the staircase. Found {0} cells, need {1}. Clear the area around the staircase.
LanguageData.SF_ExpandMountain_Tooltip: Order miners to excavate {0} additional spaces in the mountain overhead. Current: {1}/{2}
LanguageData.SF_ExpandMountain_Maxed_Tooltip: This mountain floor has reached maximum expansion based on surrounding mountain roofs ({0} spaces).
LanguageData.SF_Settings_TilesPerExpansion_Desc: The number of tiles that must be mined per expansion batch for basements and mountain upstairs. Higher values mean more work per expansion, but also more space gained at once.
